meta.launchNote: 新站候选仅表示来源域名近30天注册且当前HTTPS页面通过自动实质内容规则。首次上线时间未核实，不能把域名注册/证书签发/名单日期当上线日期。

screening.method: 按同一 seed 和 rules 对每条合规域名计算 SHA-256；在其唯一通道内按 (hash, domain) 升序取 final_quota 条。all_domains.jsonl 中每条均保留原文件、名单日期、行号、词根命中和原因代码。跨文件重复出现另存 duplicate_occurrences.jsonl。

channels.label: 原 43 词根通道
channels.rule: 非 punycode 首标签，且命中原 43 词根任一子串 AND 长度 <34 AND 无连续 3 个数字；原词表和三个条件未改，IDN 按公开优先级另入探索通道。

channels.label: 补充任务词根通道
channels.rule: 未命中任何原词根 AND 命中补充词根 AND 长度 <=40 AND 无连续 3 个数字 AND 首标签非 punycode。

channels.label: 无词根字符模式探索
channels.rule: 未命中两张词表 AND 首标签长度 5–30 AND 仅 a–z 字母及最多两个内部连字符 AND 至少一个 a/e/i/o/u AND 非 punycode；字符模式不等于可读性或有意义。

channels.label: 其余合规域名探索
channels.rule: 所有其余格式合规域名，包括数字名、长名、IDN 和未通过其他字符条件的词根命中；没有业务价值排除。

notes: 未读取网页；H1/title/description、注册日期、上线日期、搜索需求和竞争度均待后续验证。
免费来源可能是截断样本；全部输入之和不是全球当月全部新域名。
固定词表偏向英文和已知任务；两条探索通道降低这种选择偏差，但不能消除偏差。
所有格式合规域名保留在 all_domains.jsonl 与对应通道 TXT；没有按名称宣布其无价值。
首标签以 xn-- 开始的 IDN 全部分入其余合规探索通道，避免将编码中偶然出现的 qr/csv 等片段当作工具词。仍记录全部子串命中及 original_rule_pass；原 43 词表与三个字符条件作为独立审计特征不变。
工作台结果合并已保存的AI内容复核，纠正明显默认页/停放/加载壳等误收；自动初判仍完整保留在probes.jsonl。
未被抽入3000队列的域名保留在全量审计中；未核验不代表无价值。
自动内容规则：正文≥160字符且description≥40或非通用H1≥8，排除已知停放、未开放、验证和错误页。可能误判，保留原文供复核。
关键词短语为H1/title/description原文片段；尚未人工逐词核查，也未查询本轮的Google Trends或竞争度。

h1: Kalkulahin ang Iyong BMI Gamit ang BMI Calculator
domains.visibleText: Lumaktaw sa nilalaman BMI Calculator Bahay BMI Calculator Mga Kategorya FAQ Makipag-ugnayan Libre at Instant Kalkulahin ang Iyong BMI Gamit ang BMI Calculator Ilagay lamang ang iyong taas at timbang at agad kang makakakuha ng iyong Body Mass Index, kategorya ng timbang, at healthy weight range gamit ang aming BMI Calculator. Kalkulahin ang BMI Ko Tingnan ang mga Kategorya Batay sa WHO Standard na formula 100% Libre Walang sign up Instant na Resulta Sa loob ng segundo BMI Calculator Piliin ang unit at ilagay ang iyong taas at timbang para makuha agad ang iyong BMI. Metric (cm/kg) Imperial (ft/lbs) Taas (cm) Mangyaring maglagay ng taas na 50–272 cm. Timbang (kg) Mangyaring maglagay ng timbang na 15–400 kg. Kalkulahin ang BMI I-clear Punan ang form sa kaliwa para makita dito ang iyong BMI at kategorya ng timbang. 0.0 Ang Iyong BMI — 15 18.5 25 30 40+ Healthy Weight Range Batay sa iyong taas — Ang BMI ay pangkalahatang sukatan lamang at hindi isinasaalang-alang ang muscle mass, edad, o kasarian. Ano ang BMI Calculator Ang BMI Calculator ay isang libreng online na tool na tumutulong sa iyong malaman ang iyong Body Mass Index (BMI) — isang simpleng sukatan na gumagamit ng iyong taas at timbang para tantiyahin kung ikaw ay nasa malusog na saklaw ng timbang. Malawak itong ginagamit ng mga doktor at health professional bilang panimulang screening tool. Mga Kategorya ng BMI Ayon sa World Health Organization (WHO), ito ang karaniwang saklaw ng BMI para sa mga adult. Kulang sa Timbang BMI na mas mababa sa 18.5 Normal na Timbang BMI na 18.5 hanggang 24.9 Sobra sa Timbang BMI na 25 hanggang 29.9 Obese – Class I BMI na 30 hanggang 34.9 Obese – Class II BMI na 35 hanggang 39.9 Obese – Class III BMI na 40 pataas (matinding obesity) Paano Kinukwenta ang BMI Ginagamit ng BMI Calculator ang simpleng formula: hinahati ang iyong timbang (kg) sa iyong taas (metro) na pinarami sa sarili nito. BMI = timbang (kg) ÷ taas² (m²) Para sa mga gumagamit ng pounds at inches, gumagamit naman ang BMI Calculator ng katumbas na formula na pinararami ng 703. Bakit Mahalaga ang BMI Ginagamit ng mga doktor at health professional ang BMI bilang isang mabilis na paraan para tantiyahin kung ang isang tao ay nasa panganib ng mga sakit na may kaugnayan sa timbang, tulad ng diabetes, altapresyon, at sakit sa puso. Bagama't hindi ito perpektong sukatan, tumutulong ang BMI Calculator upang magsimula ang usapan tungkol sa malusog na pamumuhay kasama ang iyong doktor. Mga Limitasyon ng BMI Mahalagang tandaan na hindi perpekto ang BMI bilang sukatan ng kalusugan. Hindi nito nakikilala ang pagkakaiba ng muscle mass at taba sa katawan. Hindi isinasaalang-alang ang edad, kasarian, o pamamahagi ng taba sa katawan. Maaaring mataas ang BMI ng mga atleta kahit mababa ang taba sa katawan nila. Hindi angkop ang formula na ito para sa mga bata, buntis, at matatanda. Mga Tip Para sa Malusog na Timbang Kumain ng balanseng pagkain na may sapat na gulay, prutas, at protina. Mag-ehersisyo nang regular, kahit 30

h1: Video e trailer per le nozze
domains.visibleText: 0831 737087 346 7094339 italphoto@hotmail.it 0831 737087 346 7094339 italphoto@hotmail.it Menu Servizi fotografici a 360° Italphoto I tuoi ricordi, impressi con professionalità Romantici shooting per matrimonio Le vostre emozioni, da vedere e rivedere Video e trailer per le nozze ITALPHOTO dal 1982 al vostro servizio. Italphoto realizza shooting, scatti speciali, produzioni fotografiche e video per eventi speciali con professionalità, cura e dedizione. Situata a Mesagne, nella provincia di Brindisi, la Italphoto si conferma un punto di riferimento per il settore fin dal 1982. La pluriennale esperienza nell’immortalare emozioni e momenti magici ha reso Italphoto la scelta migliore per chi è alla ricerca di un servizio altamente performante, in grado di catturare non solo dei semplici momenti, ma vere e proprie emozioni. Tra i servizi di punta della Italphoto di Mesagne, a Brindisi, vi è sicuramente la realizzazione di shooting per matrimoni , vero tratto distintivo dello studio fotografico. Puoi contattarci per matrimoni e piccole cerimonie , chiedendoci un preventivo anche per i servizi di stampa, grafica e montaggio di video e video trailer. Le nostre non sono semplici foto, un vero e proprio ricordo fisico di un sentimento irripetibile. Lo Studio Italphoto è uno studio che offre servizi fotografici di vario genere , operando con la massima professionalità per realizzare immagini e book fotografici di alta qualità. L' esperienza trentennale dell'agenzia viene messa al servizio della clientela, per garantire fotografie uniche e ricordi senza tempo. Servizi Lo studio fotografico Italphoto si occupa della realizzazione e della stampa di book fotografici per matrimoni e cerimonie, oltre a realizzare scatti per servizi di moda e pubblicità. Inoltre l'agenzia realizza splendide riprese video, occupandosi anche del montaggio, il modo migliore per custodire i tuoi ricordi. Stampe veloci Da Italphoto vengono utilizzati solo prodotti di alta qualità, scelti tra i migliori marchi presenti nel settore fotografico. Pellicole, obiettivi, stampanti, fotocamere e tutto il resto della strumentazione appartenenti a brand importanti come: Nikon, Panasonic e Mitsubishi. h1: PNG to WEBP Converter - Convert PNG to WEBP Online
domains.visibleText: WEBPIMAGE Converter About Privacy Contact Us PNG → WEBP PNG to WEBP Converter - Convert PNG to WEBP Online Convert PNG images into high-quality, lightweight WEBP files directly in your browser. Fast, private, and free. Drop your PNG file here or browse from your device · max 12 MB Output quality 60 — Smallest file size 75 — Balanced 80 — Recommended 90 — High quality 100 — Lossless Output width Original size 512 px 1024 px 2048 px Convert to WEBP PNG to WEBP Conversion PNG (Portable Network Graphics) is a lossless raster image format widely used for logos, icons, screenshots, and any graphic that needs a transparent background. Because it is lossless, PNG files can be considerably larger than other image formats, especially for photographic content or large illustrations. WEBP is a modern image format developed by Google that supports both lossy and lossless compression, along with full alpha transparency, in a single file that is typically 25–50% smaller than an equivalent PNG. Every major browser released in the last several years supports WEBP natively, which makes it a practical drop-in replacement for PNG on the web. This free online PNG to WEBP converter handles that conversion for you directly in your browser. There is nothing to install, no plugin to configure, and no software to download — simply upload your PNG file and receive a high quality WEBP image in return, ready to save or publish. Why convert PNG to WEBP? The main reason to convert PNG to WEBP is file size. Smaller images load faster, which directly improves page speed, Core Web Vitals scores, and search engine rankings — all while keeping visual quality that is very close to the original PNG. WEBP also supports the same full alpha transparency as PNG, so logos, icons, and cut-out graphics keep their transparent backgrounds after conversion. For sites and apps where every kilobyte of bandwidth matters, switching PNG assets to WEBP is one of the simplest performance improvements available. Beyond web performance, smaller WEBP files also mean faster uploads, less storage used, and quicker load times inside apps, emails, and content management systems that support the format. Common uses for a converted WEBP image Once your PNG has been converted to WEBP, it is ready for any place where image weight and load time matter: Website images, product photos, and hero banners that need to load quickly Logos and icons embedded across a site, app, or content management system Blog graphics, thumbnails, and social media preview images Progressive web apps and mobile-friendly pages optimised for slower connections Any page being scored for Core Web Vitals or search engine page speed PNG vs WEBP: what is the difference? PNG uses lossless compression only, which guarantees pixel-perfect quality but produces larger files, particularly for images with lots of detail or many colours. O reconhecimento óptico de caracteres, conhecido como OCR, identifica letras e números nessa imagem e produz uma transcrição que você pode editar. Assim, fica mais fácil recuperar uma instrução, pesquisar um trecho ou aproveitar uma anotação sem redigitar tudo. O Converter Imagem em Texto usa esse reconhecimento para oferecer uma primeira versão do conteúdo. A foto original permanece intacta. Revisão no próprio conversor Corrija um nome, ajuste um parágrafo ou apague um trecho no campo de resultado. A cópia e o download incluem as suas alterações. Na primeira utilização, o navegador precisa carregar e preparar o modelo OCR. Aguarde a conclusão antes de trocar de arquivo; o tempo varia conforme a imagem, a conexão inicial e os recursos do aparelho. 03 Revise e salve o texto Compare a transcrição com a imagem, especialmente nomes, datas e números. h1: La côte basque comme personne ne la voit.
domains.visibleText: PLAN DE VOL PHOTO Missions Espace aérien Procédure Équipage Tarifs Décoller Missions Espace aérien Procédure Équipage Tarifs Décoller WPT 01 — SURVOL LITTORAL ALT 87 M · 1/2000 · f/4 · ISO 100 43°28′ N · 1°33′ O — Biarritz, phare & rocher de la Vierge BAT 78 % · GPS 18 sats LFBIZ BIARRITZ — QNH 1013 — VENT 12 KT O La côte basque comme personne ne la voit. Photographie et vidéo aériennes par télépilote agréé DGAC : immobilier d'exception, événements, littoral et travaux. Plan de vol déclaré, assurances à jour, livraison sous 48 h — la réglementation n'est pas notre contrainte, c'est notre métier. Voir les missions La procédure 120 m plafond autorisé 4K photo + vidéo 48 h livraison Briefing avant vol Un beau cadre aérien, c'est 80 % de préparation au sol. Les 20 % restants, c'est le talent — et le vent qui décide. Scénarios européens STS déclarés, analyses de risques, autorisations en zone peuplée : nous volons proprement parce que nous préparons sérieusement. Chaque mission part d'un plan de vol écrit — créneaux, altitudes, points de vue, plan B météo — que vous validez avant le décollage. Nous connaissons la côte basque par la mer et par le vent : les lumières d'octobre, les houles de février, les toits de Biarritz et les vignes d'Irouléguy. Ce que le drone ajoute, ce n'est pas de la hauteur — c'est du point de vue. Plan de mission & grille 2026–2027 Quatre types de mission 01 ALT 20-60 m Survol immobilier · 30 min Propriétés d'exception : vue d'ensemble, approches, jardin et accès. Repérage et plan de vol inclus, retouche ciel/luminosité, compatibilité portails immobiliers — 15 à 25 visuels retouchés + 60 s de vidéo. 250 € Commander 02 ALT 50-120 m Immobilier pack · 1 h Le complet pour un mandat : drone extérieur + photos au sol des pièces maîtresses. 25 visuels aériens + 20 au sol, plan 2D de la propriété offert, livraison 48 h — un seul prestataire, une annonce qui change de catégorie. 390 € Commander 03 S1/S3 Événement · 2 h Compétitions, inaugurations, mariages en extérieur : couverture aérienne + planches au sol, déclarations spécifiques en zone peuplée gérées par nous — 40 visuels + 2 min de vidéo montée, droits diffusion 2 ans inclus. 590 € Commander 04 multi-sites Film + photos · journée Pour les territoires, offices de tourisme et entreprises : film aérien court (2-3 min, sonorisé) + banque photo complète. Storyboard validé en amont, tournage sur une journée, déclinaisons réseaux sociaux incluses. 790 € Commander Report météo sans frais (vent > 25 kt, pluie, plafond bas). Deux points de vue supplémentaires sur site : 60 € chacun. Autorisations spécifiques en zone contrôlée : temps réel facturé 45 €/h. Droits publicitaires étendus : sur devis. Espace aérien & conformité Ce que « télépilote agréé » veut dire, concrètement DGAC Exploitant déclaré, télépilote breveté théorique et pratique (arrêté du 17.12.2015, scénarios S1-S3, STS-01/02). Assurances RC Pro drone (dommages au tiers) + assurance exploitant. Attestations transmises avant chaq

domains.title: darktable Agentic - AI copilot for RAW photo editing The darktable Agentic architecture, from MCP client down to the live darkroom pixelpipe
domains.description: darktable Agentic is an open source AI copilot for RAW photo editing: an MCP server and a patched darktable fork that let an AI edit your live darkroom.
h1: darktable Agentic: an AI copilot for RAW photo editing
domains.visibleText: Skip to content darktable Agentic Why Features Session Culling How it works Install Status FAQ Light theme darktable Agentic: an AI copilot for RAW photo editing A copilot for your darkroom. Not an autopilot. An open source MCP server and a patched darktable fork that let an AI collaborator work inside your live darkroom: it reads the real module parameters of the RAW you have open, proposes one concrete step, applies it, renders the pipeline, and shows you the result. You stay the editor. Download .deb (Ubuntu 24.04) Get it on GitHub How it works Open source. Self-hosted. Linux. GPL-3.0 fork of darktable , MIT server, built on the Model Context Protocol . Why this exists darktable is deep, and most of us use the part we learned first A conversation partner that knows the whole surface changes which tools you reach for. darktable has a genuinely deep toolset, and most photographers work with a comfortable fraction of it. A collaborator that knows the rest can say "that halo is the local contrast module, not the tone curve", or "for this you probably want the tone equalizer rather than pushing shadows in exposure", and then show you what that looks like. The practical win is not that the work gets done for you. It is that you end up using more of what darktable can actually do. You describe the outcome, not the control. "Warm it up, but keep the shadows neutral" is one sentence. Doing it is white balance plus color balance rgb, plus knowing which of the four-way sliders is shadows. You say the thing you want, and the AI tells you which control it reached for, so next time you know too. Why the enabling work had to happen in C Stock darktable's Lua API cannot support this. It exposes images, films, tags, styles, storages and GUI actions, but not the live develop state: no module parameters, no history, no masks, no way to read back what the pixelpipe just produced. The available workarounds are all dead ends for an agent: darktable-cli never loads the user's library and cannot touch a live darkroom. dt.gui.action drives GUI widgets, which means single-image, focus-dependent, GUI-only, and it gives no readback of values or bounds. Writing XMP sidecars or poking library.db bypasses the running instance entirely, so you see nothing until a reload. So the fork adds a darktable.develop Lua namespace in C: introspection-driven read and write of any module's parameters, masks, and a live uncommitted preview grab. That is what turned "click a slider through the GUI automation layer" into "read the real parameter, clamp against its real bounds, write it, reprocess". What it can do Conversational RAW editing, masks, retouch and culling Every capability below acts on the photo currently open in your darkroom, through typed tools, with the result rendered back so the AI can judge it. domains.title: Silicon Photonics and Quantum Computing | SiP Explained Light paths crossing a silicon photonic chip
domains.description: Learn how silicon photonics enables quantum computing, networking, and sensing through integrated photon sources, waveguides, circuits, and detectors.
domains.visibleText: Skip to content SiP PHOTONICS + QUANTUM Silicon photonics Photonic computing Japan’s SIP program FIELD GUIDE 01 — SILICON + LIGHT Silicon photonics meets quantum. How chips that guide light could help quantum systems compute, communicate, and sense at scale. Start with the fundamentals → Explore photonic computing SiPh / QPU 10⁻⁶ m chip-scale paths c information carried by light PHOTON GENERATION ◆ WAVEGUIDES ◆ INTERFERENCE ◆ SINGLE-PHOTON DETECTION 01 / FOUNDATION What is silicon photonics? Silicon photonics is the design and manufacture of optical components on silicon chips. Instead of moving only electrical signals through metal wires, these circuits guide light through microscopic waveguides. Modulators control it, interferometers combine it, and detectors convert it back into electrical signals. The technology grew around high-speed communications. Quantum engineers now use the same fabrication ideas to generate, manipulate, and measure quantum states of light on an integrated platform. CORE IDEA Put many optical functions on one manufacturable chip, then use photons to carry and process information. 02 / THE SYSTEM From photon to processor A useful photonic quantum chip needs an entire chain—not one magic component. 01 Generate Laser-driven nonlinear structures or integrated emitters create single photons or entangled photon pairs. 02 Encode Quantum information is encoded in path, time-bin, polarization, frequency, or continuous optical variables. 03 Interfere Beam splitters, phase shifters, and interferometers transform optical modes and produce quantum operations. 04 Detect Single-photon detectors measure outputs. Electronics interpret results and can feed corrections back into the circuit. 03 / WHY SILICON Why build quantum optics on silicon? 01 Manufacturing maturity Silicon can draw on decades of semiconductor process development, precise lithography, and repeatable wafer-scale production. 02 Dense integration Long optical experiments assembled on a laboratory table can become compact networks of waveguides and interferometers. 03 Electronic control Photonic circuits can sit near drivers, readout electronics, and conventional processors needed to operate a quantum system. 04 Network compatibility Photons naturally carry quantum information across optical links, making them central to quantum communication and distributed computing. 04 / REALITY CHECK Light travels well. Computing with it is hard. Photons interact weakly with their surroundings, which helps preserve quantum states. That same property makes deterministic two-qubit operations difficult. Many linear-optical operations are probabilistic and require extra photons, measurements, and active feed-forward. Loss remains the defining engineering problem. A missing photon is missing information. Efficient sources, low-loss packaging, fast switching, high-performance detectors, and fault-tolerant architectures must work together. domains.visibleText: VideoUpscaler Blog Free AI video upscaler online Free AI Video Upscaler An ai video upscaler re-creates a low-resolution clip at a higher resolution. A 480p security cam video or an old 720p phone clip becomes a 1080p or 4K file, and the extra detail is drawn by a neural network rather than copied from the source. That is why a good upscaler keeps edges, faces, and small text readable instead of turning them into soft blobs. Recommended AI Video Upscalers You do not have to run anything on your own machine. A few services do the heavy lifting on their servers and hand you a ready file. Here are the options we like, and the full breakdown lives in our best AI video upscalers guide. Topaz Video AI , the desktop reference for quality. HitPaw Video Enhancer , the easiest option for beginners. Tensorpix , a browser-based tool that needs no install. Step-by-step instructions for all of them are on our how to upscale video page. If you are still choosing between free and paid, read our guide to the AI video enhancer options available today. What an AI Video Upscaler Does A simple resizer stretches the picture and calls it done. An ai video upscaler does much more. It studies each frame, estimates the pixels that are missing, and adds plausible detail. The result depends on the model. Some are trained to sharpen faces, others to clean up compression noise from streaming sites, and a few handle both jobs at once. Two numbers matter when you plan a job: the source resolution and the target resolution. Moving from 720p to 1080p is a 1.5x jump and looks great on most clips. Moving from 480p to 4K is a much bigger ask, and the model has to invent a lot of detail. You will get a cleaner image either way, but do not expect magic on a heavily compressed source. Because the work happens on a GPU, processing takes time. A two-minute clip can take ten minutes or an hour depending on the tool, the model, and your hardware. That is the trade-off for the quality gain. How to Upscale Video with AI Pick your source clip and check its real resolution. Open the file properties on your computer or the details panel in your video app. Choose a target resolution. 1080p is the sweet spot for most everyday footage. Go to 4K only when you need extra headroom for cropping or zooming. Select a model. Face and detail models are best for people; denoise models are best for old or compressed footage. Run the job on a short test clip first so you can judge quality and time before you commit to a long render. Compare the output against the source at 100 percent. Look at the edges of moving objects and at fine texture like hair or grass. Export with a sensible codec. H.264 or H.265 at a high bitrate keeps the new detail without bloating the file. Benefits of Browser-Based Processing Unlike traditional online tools, OnlyResize does not require you to upload files to a server. There is no upload or download waiting time, and files are processed directly on your device. For most common image and video resizing tasks, browser-based processing is fast and convenient. How Does OnlyResize Protect Your Privacy? Many online tools focus on secure file transfers, but your files still need to be uploaded to a remote server for processing. OnlyResize works differently: your files never leave your device. Processing takes place locally in your browser, similar to using traditional desktop software. This makes it a convenient choice when you need to resize private or sensitive images and videos. How Does Browser-Based Processing Compare with Server-Side Processing? Browser-based processing depends on the hardware and available memory of your computer or phone, so very large files or multiple files may exceed the limits of your device. In some cases, a large image or video may fail to process because of available memory. Server-side tools can be more suitable for extremely large files because the processing is handled by remote servers. For most everyday image and video resizing tasks, however, browser-based processing is fast and convenient. How Does Browser-Based Image Resizing Work? OnlyResize uses modern WebAssembly (WASM) technology to perform image and video processing directly in your browser. WebAssembly is a web standard supported by major modern browsers that allows high-performance code to run efficiently on the web. In simple terms, it lets applications traditionally run as desktop software work directly inside your browser. The required processing engine is downloaded and cached on your device when you first use the tool, so it can be reused for future processing. Use a Computer for Better Performance Desktop and laptop computers generally have more processing power and memory than mobile devices, making them better suited for large files or multiple images and videos. For the best performance, close unnecessary programs and browser tabs while processing large files. Use Your System's Default Browser Some third-party apps use built-in browsers that may restrict certain web features or affect performance. For the best experience and full access to the tool's features, we recommend opening OnlyResize directly in your system's default browser. Use a Modern Browser and Keep It Updated For the best experience, use an up-to-date version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera or Safari. 当大多数恋爱番急着在第一话就告白，《初恋时间》动漫选择用十二集去讲清一个下午的犹豫。这份专题把初恋时间动画的剧情线、角色关系、分集彩蛋与幕后资讯，整理成一条可以慢慢走完的时间轴。 查看分集看点 先读剧情速览 12 全话数 24min 单集时长 9.6 站内评分 08 已更新集 剧情速览 看角色档案 → 情境：打开追番列表，却不知道从哪一部开始 打开任何一个平台，新番列表都能刷出两三屏。筛选条件越点越多，真正能让人记住名字的却越来越少。如果你也在找一部节奏不快、情绪却足够扎实的作品，那么《初恋时间》动漫值得被放进候选名单的第一位。它不靠高概念取胜，靠的是把一件小事讲透的耐心。 冲突：恋爱番越拍越多，能记住的却越来越少 同质化的校园恋爱动画正在消耗观众的耐心：第三话必然出现的雨天、第七话必然响起的烟花、最终话必然错过的末班车。《初恋时间》动漫没有绕开这些符号，而是把它们拆开重排，让熟悉感服务于情绪，而不是替代情绪。这一点，在 分集看点 里体现得格外明显。 问题：怎样才算一部值得二刷的青春恋爱动画 判断标准其实很朴素：第一遍看故事，第二遍看细节。初恋时间动画在第 03 话埋下的橡皮擦特写、第 07 话背景里一闪而过的社团招新海报，都是只有重看才会注意到的信息。这类细节密度，才是作品愿意被反复讨论的底气，也是我们在 作品分类 里把它单独归档的原因。 答案：《初恋时间》动漫给出的慢速解法 它把十二集切成四个季节，每一季只推进一个关系阶段。初恋时间全集看下来，你会发现叙事重心始终放在「没说出口的那句话」上。整部作品真正的高潮不在告白现场，而在告白之前那三秒钟的沉默里。想确认这个判断，可以先看 角色档案 ，再看一遍第 08 话的走廊长镜头。 角色档案 聊聊你的本命 → 初恋时间动漫里没有绝对的配角，每个人都在用自己的方式错过，也用自己的方式靠近。 林知夏 摄影社 · 高二 把心事写进错题本的人。她的镜头永远对准别人，唯独没有对准自己。 江野 转学生 · 高二 总在迟到的人。他记得所有公交时刻表，却记不住自己说过的话。 苏晚 学生会 · 高三 最清醒的那个人。她负责说出所有别人不敢说的台词。 陈屿 天文社 · 高三 毕业前最后一次社团活动，他把望远镜留给了学弟。 分集看点 查看全部条目 → 01 第一话 · 四月的雨伞 开场七分钟没有一句对白，全靠雨声和脚步完成人物介绍，被不少观众称为近年最安静的动画开场。 03 第三话 · 错题本上的批注 橡皮擦特写只出现了四帧，却交代了女主角三年来的全部心事。这是《初恋时间》动漫最常被截图的一幕。 05 第五话 · 天台上的两分钟 整话只有两个人、一个长镜头。初恋时间动画在这里第一次让配乐完全退场。 07 第七话 · 被退回的信 背景里一闪而过的社团招新海报，暗示了第二季的时间线走向。 08 第八话 · 走廊尽头的光 本季目前评分最高的一话，站内短评量在更新后 24 小时内翻了三倍。 作品分类 参与讨论 → 全部条目 校园恋爱 青春治愈 慢热日常 漫画改编 剧场版剪辑 声优访谈 原声音乐 Comparatif indépendant · sans test inventé Compresseur d'air : lequel choisir Le mot « silencieux » ne veut rien dire tant qu'on n'a pas lu le chiffre en décibels, et il est écrit dans la fiche. Nous les avons ouvertes une par une pour séparer ce qui est vérifiable de ce qui ne l'est pas. 29 compresseurs comparés ( 8 compacts, 10 en 50 litres, 11 en 100 litres, dont 11 sous 65 dB) : prix, notes, niveau sonore et nombre d'avis relevés sur Amazon.fr le 23 septembre 2026 Voir le comparatif Guide d'achat Ce que nous avons trouvé en ouvrant les 29 fiches Un compresseur se choisit sur trois chiffres : la cuve, qui donne le temps de travail avant que le moteur ne reparte ; le débit, qui dit quel outil il peut alimenter ; et le niveau sonore, qui décide si vous pourrez vous en servir un dimanche matin. Les deux premiers figurent presque toujours dans les fiches. Le troisième est le plus intéressant, parce que c'est celui dont personne ne parle correctement. Aucune norme ne définit ce qu'est un compresseur silencieux. Le mot est une promesse commerciale, pas une mesure. Le chiffre, lui, est écrit noir sur blanc : ABAC EASE-AIR 6 annonce 49 dB quand Stanley DN200/10/5 en annonce 98 , soit 49 décibels d'écart. Et deux modèles de même cuve portant la même promesse peuvent différer de 13 décibels : Ribimex PRCOMP3/100SILR s'appelle « compresseur silencieux » et annonce 75 dB, Mecafer Power N' Silent 100 L en annonce 62 . Ce n'est pas un mensonge, c'est une échelle que le vocabulaire ne rend pas. Sur 3 fiches, aucun niveau sonore n'est indiqué du tout. Nous ne leur en inventons pas : elles sortent des classements par le bruit, et le site le dit. 5 fiches annoncent une valeur qui ne peut pas être vraie. Un compresseur vendu moins de 80 euros et pesant 5,4 kilos ne peut pas avoir une cuve de 227 litres. Un autre est donné pour 10 grammes. Un troisième annonce une puissance très supérieure à celle que son propre descriptif indique. Nous les gardons au comparatif, parce qu'ils se vendent et qu'ils sont souvent bons, mais chaque fiche concernée porte la mention de ce qui cloche. Dernier piège, invisible celui-là : 2 produits de notre relevé se partagent un même compteur d'avis. Sua aplicação pode favorecer o suporte sensório-motor, estimular a percepção corporal e auxiliar na função dos músculos envolvidos na deglutição, sempre integrada a um plano terapêutico individualizado e baseado nas necessidades de cada paciente. Sobre Mim Fonoaudióloga formada pela USP de Ribeirão Preto, com experiência na avaliação e reabilitação de adultos, idosos e crianças. Minha atuação é voltada especialmente à reabilitação neurológica, acompanhando pacientes com sequelas de AVC, afasias, disfagias e doenças neurodegenerativas. O cuidado é individualizado e busca promover comunicação, segurança, funcionalidade e autonomia, contribuindo para uma melhor qualidade de vida em todas as fases do tratamento. A Fonoaudiologia Infantil acompanha o desenvolvimento da comunicação, fala, linguagem e alimentação da criança, respeitando cada fase e suas necessidades individuais. Explore the Methodology Get Started The Drawdown Dilemma Why unmanaged downside quietly ends most side-hustle investing Most people who try to build a secondary income from markets are not undone by a single bad decision. They are undone by a string of small, unmanaged losses that compound while attention is elsewhere — at work, with family, or simply asleep. Traditional "buy and hope" approaches rely on the investor noticing a downturn in time and reacting calmly. In practice, both conditions fail together: attention is limited, and emotion clouds judgement exactly when clarity matters most. Norveqra AI was built around a different premise: that risk should be defined and enforced before a position is even opened, using statistical modelling rather than in-the-moment judgement. Disclosure is the trail itself, offered as a product: per-node feed of what every issuer filed as it lands; jurisdiction exports of records and twelve-month trail; the provenance log — where each field came from, when it was read, what changed between drops; and the query log, kept in-region, of what a firm's agents asked and were answered. Public-record only; nothing a data licence could pull back. London first: brokers, wealth managers and platforms under the FCA product governance rules (PROD) take the UK node's trail as the feed, RNS, the FCA National Storage Mechanism and Companies House as its sources, nothing licensed on the wire. Toronto next: the same feed from the Canada node for the KYP file. Then the other nine markets. Scope 1.1 Unit: the disclosure event — date, type, title as published, category, reference, URL of the regulator's or exchange's copy. 1.2 Window: trailing twelve months per issuer, refreshed by the weekly sweep of each node. 1.3 Events at render: 2386878 across 11 live nodes (list_nodes). h1: Turn one photo into a cinematic still
domains.visibleText: Skip to content Drama Generator Movie Poster Generator Superhero Generator Costume Generator Free · Google sign-in · no watermark Turn one photo into a cinematic still Three focused generators. Upload a single photo, pick a look, and get a poster-grade image back. Nothing to install, nothing to pay. Choose a generator AI Movie Poster Generator One photo in. A poster-grade portrait out. Open the generator → AI Superhero Generator Your face. An original suit. One hero shot. Open the generator → AI Costume Generator See the costume on you before you commit to it. Open the generator → How it works Three steps, one photo Every generator on this site runs the same loop. The difference between them is the prompt and the style presets, which are tuned per use case rather than shared. 1 Pick a look Each generator ships four presets. They change the lighting, palette and mood, not your face. 2 Add one photo A clear, front-facing photo of one person holds likeness best. JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB. 3 Get your image It usually takes about a minute. At busy times it can take longer — tick “Email me when it’s ready” and close the page. Straight answers What this site will and will not do It will not copy existing characters. Every prompt asks for original designs. We do not reproduce trademarked heroes, costumes, logos or wordmarks. It will not remove clothing or alter bodies. Every prompt carries a safety clause that keeps subjects clothed and age-appropriate, and preserves real facial identity. It will not keep your photo. Your upload is used only to make your image and is deleted as soon as it’s done — never kept longer than three days. We keep a job record and the link to the result, never the original file and never your raw IP address. It stays free. No payment, no watermark. There is a small daily limit per person, which is what lets a free tool stay free. Drama Generator Free AI tools that turn one photo into a movie poster, a superhero still, or a costume portrait. Generated images are produced by a third-party model and are not guaranteed to be accurate, original, or free of resemblance to existing works. h1: 多平台媒体解析， 一个接口就够了。
domains.visibleText: Media Parser API 在线解析 平台能力 部署方式 接入示例 常见问题 登录 注册 创建账号 Star on GitHub 多平台媒体解析， 一个接口就够了。 输入任意支持平台的分享链接，统一获取视频、图集、封面、音频与作者信息。无需浏览器环境，既可在线使用，也可通过 API 接入你的业务。 立即在线解析 查看 API 示例 统一 JSON 返回 API Key 鉴权 独立 QPS 限制 GET /api/v1/parse curl --get 'https://your-domain.com/api/v1/parse' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer mp-xxx' \ --data-urlencode 'url=https://v.douyin.com/xxx/' { "succ" : true , "data" : { "platform" : "抖音" , "video_url" : "https://..." , "image_list" : [] } } LIVE PARSER 粘贴链接，立即解析 支持分享短链和包含链接的完整分享文案。 媒体分享链接 开始解析 粘贴内容 清空 正在识别平台并获取媒体信息… 暂时无法解析该内容 排查建议 · 复制完整 JSON 格式化复制 视觉媒体预览 JSON 原始结构 视频文件预览 ( 0 ) 新窗口打开 复制直链 ← 上一个 下一个 → 点击在新窗口播放 背景音频 字幕/歌词 ( 0 ) 高清图集/封面 ( 0 ) 未解析到可直观预览的多媒体资源 × 复制图片链接 打开图片 ↗ 复制实况视频 打开实况 ↗ ONE ENDPOINT 面向真实业务的解析能力 解析器按平台独立维护，对外保持一致的数据结构。后台可随时关闭异常平台，不影响其他接口。 01 多类型媒体 统一获取视频、图集、Live Photo、背景音频、封面及字幕。 02 密钥与限流 每位客户独立管理 API Key，支持用户级、密钥级和平台级 QPS。 03 状态可控制 管理员可控制全局服务和单个平台，并配置客户有效期。 04 调用可追踪 记录平台、响应状态、错误码和耗时，快速定位解析异常。 OPEN SOURCE & DEPLOYMENT 完全开源自建，按需灵活落地 基于宽松的 MIT 协议开放，零商业授权门槛。解析引擎、业务数据与运行基础设施由部署者全权自主掌控。 MIT LICENSE 个人与轻量自用 适用于学习研究、个人工具开发与轻量级自动化集成 ¥0 / 永久开源 完整开放源码与标准 JSON 规范 Docker Compose 单机快速启动 透明无暗桩，通过 GitHub 社区交流 查看源码与部署文档 SELF-HOSTED GATEWAY 团队私有网关 适合将解析能力部署为团队或业务系统的统一内部服务 开箱即用 / 内置中台管控 租户、API Key、有效期与积分体系 用户 / 密钥 / 平台三级精细化流控 平台熔断开关、调用日志与用量统计 查看 API 接入方式 DATA PRIVACY & COMPLIANCE 私有自治与合规 私有网络独立运行，数据不过第三方，保障业务稳定与合规 自主掌控 / 本地私有运行 私网独立部署，无第三方调用与数据泄露风险 目标平台 Cookie 与密钥凭据完全本地化自管 自主把握频次，严格遵守目标平台使用规则 查看开源协议与合规须知 QUICK START GET 接口，小白也能用 注册并由管理员开通有效期后，在控制台创建 API Key。推荐使用请求头传递密钥，也兼容直接放入查询参数。 注册账号 进入控制台 # 最简单的 URL 调用方式 GET /api/v1/parse? key =mp-xxx& url =分享链接 # 推荐：密钥放在请求头 Authorization: Bearer mp-xxx FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS 常见问题解答 解答你在对接与使用 Media Parser API 过程中的常见疑问。 解析出来的视频和图集是高清无水印的吗？ Media Parser 会尽量返回目标平台当前可获取的原始媒体地址，不主动对资源进行二次压缩。实际清晰度和水印情况取决于作品、平台接口、登录状态及平台后续调整，无法对所有链接作统一保证。 提取出的音视频/图片直链会过期或遭遇防盗链吗？ 可能会。媒体地址通常由目标平台的 CDN 提供，可能包含时效签名、登录校验或防盗链策略，具体有效期由平台决定。对于拥有合法保存权且需要持久化的内容，请在解析后及时转存到自己的存储服务。 遇到目标平台改版导致解析失败怎么办？ 请先更新到项目最新版本，并检查该平台是否需要 Cookie 等额外配置。如果问题仍然存在，可携带脱敏后的示例链接和错误日志提交 GitHub Issue。开源自部署实例不会自动热更新，升级前请先在自己的环境中验证。 如何获取和配置 API Key？ 自部署后，首次访问 /auth/setup 创建管理员。用户登录控制台后可以创建和管理自己的 API Key；调用接口时推荐使用 Authorization: Bearer mp-xxx ，也兼容 ?key=mp-xxx 查询参数。 QPS、有效期和解析积分如何配置？ 这些限制均由自部署实例的管理员配置，并非固定商业套餐。默认新用户试用期为 7 天、初始积分为 100、账号限制为 2 QPS；管理员可在后台调整。触发 QPS 限制时返回 429，积分耗尽时返回 402，账号未开通或过期时返回 403。 Media Parser API · 多平台媒体解析服务 系统正常运行 GitHub

domains.title: Repurposing Video — Turn your video into a full content pack
domains.description: Send your video. Get a pack you can publish: shorts, summary, transcript, blog, newsletter, and posts for X, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
h1: Turn 1 Video Into a Complete Content Pack
domains.visibleText: VIDEO REPURPOSING · DONE FOR YOU Contact Us Turn 1 Video Into a Complete Content Pack Send us one video. We turn it into shareable clips, a newsletter, blog post, summary, full transcript, glossary, mind map, infographic, and posts for X, LinkedIn, Facebook and much more.... Studio New Video Shorts Captioned vertical clips of the best moments, cut from the recording and ready to post. Make clips → Highlights Timestamped Key Points The moments worth remembering after someone watches, tied back to the clock so they can jump straight there. See highlights → Write Editorial Summary A clean summary, not a recap of every side story. Written so a new visitor understands the piece quickly & easily. Read summary → Transcribe Clean Transcript Readable, timed, and easy to search. Filler is trimmed so the page still feels like you speaking. View transcript → Studio Mind Map A simple visual of how the ideas connect, built from the recording so the argument is easy to see. Open map → Studio New Infographic A shareable graphic that carries the argument at a glance, ready to post or drop into the pack. Make graphic → Research Glossary & Resources The terms that appear in the conversation, plus the sources mentioned, defined in plain language. Open glossary → Write Blog Post A full post with a title, meta description, headings, and a body that can live on your site and earn search traffic. Draft article → Write Newsletter Subject line, preview text, and a letter you can send to the list. Draft edition → Social X Post A standalone post and a thread, written for the way X is actually read. Write post → Social LinkedIn In your voice, ready to paste — a post written for how that feed is actually read. Write post → Social Facebook Ready copy for the Facebook feed, written so it sounds like you and not a press release. Write post → Send a Video See a Finished Example The Problem Most people we talk to are not short on ideas. They are short on the hours after the recording stops. If this sounds like your week, you are the person this is for. A The video is done. Nothing else got made from it. You already recorded it. Then the week got busy. The clips, the letter, and the posts never happened. B Publish day leaves you a link and a thumbnail. No page you can send. No letter you can mail. No posts you can schedule. Once the upload spike is over, the content stops working. C The video took a morning. The content week takes days more. You still have to pull the transcript, write the letter, draft the social posts, cut the shorts, and get a blog live. D That second job is why good videos go quiet. You do not have those hours. So one recording stays one upload. E Your audience is not only on one app. The people who would buy, subscribe, or book a call are on email, LinkedIn, search, X, and Facebook. One upload does not reach them. F What you only said out loud does not travel. Google, newsletters, and sales follow-ups run on text. Spoken points do not rank. They do not paste.

domains.visibleText: Skip to main content Agentic Engineers Beta Course Sign in Start Become an agentic engineer. You will not write most of the code. You will decide what gets built, direct the agent that writes it, and answer for what ships. That is a skill, and this is where you learn it. Start “engineering” to emphasize that there is an art & science and expertise to it. It's something you can learn and become better at, with its own depth of a different kind. Andrej Karpathy, naming the practice. February 2026 Introducing Agentic Engineers The floor has come up. The bar has not moved. Anyone can get working code out of a model now. What nobody can do for you is decide what to build, notice when the agent is confidently wrong, and take responsibility for the thing that ships. That work did not go away. It became most of the job. So this teaches the job, not the tool. Griddy asks you what you have built, maps out the course you need, and teaches from sources you can open and check. Then it reviews what you build. You get the leverage. You do not get to skip the judgment. An agent you can ask to show its work. Follow an answer back to its source. See why your learning path changed. Open the record behind a lesson. Griddy gives you ways to inspect the work behind the response. Go straight to the source. Open the passage behind Griddy ’s answer and check it for yourself. A path that responds to your work. Checkpoint results help Griddy identify what you’re ready for next. See what’s behind the lesson. Its sources, review record, and content version are there to inspect. A learning path built around your goals. Start with a conversation, and Griddy connects your goals to the skills you need. Your course brings the foundations and relevant specializations into one map, with each lesson connected to what comes before it. Build your learning path Feedback that tells you what to work on. Put the lesson to work, then submit your code, explanation, or project evidence. Griddy reviews it against the checkpoint and points you back to relevant practice. Griddy already has the lesson context. Select a passage and ask about it. Work through unfamiliar code or challenge an explanation. Griddy draws on the lesson and its sources, so the conversation starts where you are. Your lesson and your agent, in the same workspace. Open the record behind the lesson. See where the material came from, when it was reviewed, and which version you’re reading. The source and review record lives beside the lesson, ready when you want to look closer. The same habit carries into your projects: inspect the source, check the result, and understand what you’re shipping. In every scenario, a DA checker saves time, sharpens decision-making, and helps you allocate your energy where it will have the greatest impact. Moreover, DA checkers serve as a progress tracker. By checking your domain authority regularly, you can see the tangible results of your SEO efforts. How to Create a QR Code That Scans Reliably A QR code is a two-dimensional barcode that can store a URL, plain text, contact details, Wi-Fi credentials, or other data. Modern smartphones read them instantly with the built-in camera. To make a code that works well in the real world, follow a few proven rules. 1. Keep high contrast Dark modules on a light background give the highest scan success rate. Aim for a contrast ratio of at least 4:1. Avoid light gray on white or dark colors on a dark background. The generator above lets you pick any colors — test the result on a real phone before printing. 2. Size matters For close-range scanning (menus, business cards, product packaging) a printed size of about 2 × 2 cm (roughly 0.8 inch) is usually enough. For posters or signs viewed from farther away, scale the code up. A simple rule of thumb is the 10:1 distance-to-size ratio: if people will scan from 1 meter away, make the code at least 10 cm wide. 3. Leave a quiet zone Every QR code needs a clear margin (the “quiet zone”) of at least four modules on all four sides. Crowding the code against other graphics or the edge of a page makes it harder for cameras to detect the boundaries. 4. Prefer short content Shorter data produces simpler, more robust codes. If you are linking to a long web address, create a short URL first and encode that instead. This reduces the density of the pattern and improves scanning under imperfect lighting or with older phone cameras. Common Uses for QR Codes in 2026 Menus & restaurants – link to a digital menu or ordering page so guests never touch a physical booklet. Business cards – put a QR code that opens your contact card, LinkedIn profile, or portfolio. Product packaging – connect buyers to instructions, warranty registration, or authenticity checks. Event tickets & check-in – speed up entry and reduce paper waste. Wi-Fi sharing – encode network name and password so guests join with one scan. Marketing campaigns – track which posters or flyers drive the most visits by using unique short links behind each code. Payment & donations – link to a payment page or digital wallet request. Support FAQs Everything you need to know about how the Carver Agent Legality Check works. Is my AI agent legal? It depends on what the agent does, who it talks to and where they are. Describe those three things and the service returns, on a best-effort basis, the acts that may reach the agent and the obligations inside them, marked applies, undetermined or ruled out. It is not legal advice. What do I need to provide? A few sentences on what the agent does, who it interacts with and where they are located. Issuers is the issuer side of the graph: a listed company's own record — legal name, identifiers, auditor, registrar, fiscal period, disclosure trail — as every dealer agent sees it, with the source on each field. Confirm it, correct it at the source, and it is live to every agent on the estate. Signing lands with cm-record.org. domains.visibleText: Money Robot Home Pricing Testimonials Contact Us Start for Free ➤ Login Website Link Checker Grow Organic Traffic For FREE Get ranked on Google and recommended by ChatGPT Gemini DeepSeek Claude Perplexity Copilot Grok ➤ Enter Your Website ➤ Enter Your Keywords ➤ START Link Building in just a Second World's best Backlinks Software 1,000,000+ Customers & Growing 🔗 Check Website Backlinks ➤ Enter Your Website ➤ CHECK Website Backlinks Check website backlinks More Details + Website Link Checker: Your Essential Guide to a Healthy, High-Performing Website Every website you visit is built on a network of links connecting pages, resources, and content. Behind the scenes, those links do far more than simply move a visitor from one page to another. They guide search engines through your site, tell users what to explore next, and establish the authority and relevance of every page. A website link checker is the tool that ensures every single one of those connections is working exactly as it should, so your site remains fast, accessible, and optimized for both humans and search engines. Whether you manage a personal blog, an e-commerce store with thousands of product pages, or a corporate website with nested navigation menus, link health is a foundational element of your digital presence. A dedicated link checker automates the tedious process of auditing every URL on your site, flagging anything that needs attention, and giving you a clear roadmap to keep your website in top shape. In this guide, we will walk through everything you need to know about using a website link checker effectively, from understanding the core technology behind it to leveraging the results to elevate your SEO strategy and user experience. What Is a Website Link Checker and Why Does It Matter? A website link checker is a software tool that crawls your website the same way a search engine bot or a visitor would, visiting every page and testing every link it encounters along the way. It examines both internal links, which point to other pages within your own domain, and external links, which lead to third-party websites. As it goes through your site, it records the HTTP status code returned for each link. A 200 status means the page loaded successfully. A 301 or 302 indicates a redirect. A 404 means the page no longer exists. A 500-series code signals a server-side problem. By collecting all of this data, the checker produces a comprehensive report you can review and act upon. The importance of this cannot be overstated. Links are the connective tissue of the web. When a link is broken, a visitor hits a dead end, which creates frustration and erodes trust in your brand. When search engines crawl your site and encounter a cluster of dead links, it sends a subtle signal that the site is not well maintained. domains.title: Экран объявлений — гости пишут на экран заведения
domains.description: Гость сканирует код, собирает объявление на своём телефоне и оно появляется на экране в зале. Заведению — свой экран для афиш и доля с рекламы.
domains.visibleText: О сервисе · Как подключиться · Баннер на сайте · Оборудование · Инструкция · Условия · Кабинет заведения RU EN qrekran.ru Экран, на котором пишут гости Телевизор в зале показывает афиши заведения, например фотографии с блюдами и ценами на них. А ещё любой гость со своего телефона сможет разместить на экране объявление всего за минуту, например поздравить с днем рождения именинника. Как это выглядит 1 Гость видит код Код QR на экране и на столах. Наводит на QR камеру телефона — открывается страница. 2 Собирает объявление Фотография или видео, две надписи, цвет. Двигает пальцем прямо по кадру и видит, как это будет на экране. 3 Видит свое объявление на экране Объявление появляется в зале через секунду и висит заданное время. Потом экран возвращается к ротации афиш заведения. Что это даёт заведению Экран работает на вас и без гостей: бесплатно крутит меню, афишу, часы работы, новинки. Кадры вы добавляете сами в кабинете и отмечаете галочками, что показывать. Позже объявления гостей станут платными и вы станете получать не менее 60% дохода от размещения объявлений гостей. Каждый экран станет приносить доход вашему заведению! Гости приводят гостей Объявление гостя видит весь зал, а сам гость делится им с друзьями и выкладывает у себя в сетях. Заведение попадает в кадр бесплатно. Что для этого нужно Телевизор с входом HDMI, небольшая приставка и интернет в заведении. Приставка ставится за десять минут, дальше всё делается с телефона. А можно без приставки? Можно, если ваш телевизор работает на Android TV или Google TV — это одна и та же система, приложение у них общее. Тогда приставка не нужна и вы экономите её стоимость. Не подходят телевизоры, которые работают не на Android, прежде всего Samsung и LG : для них нужна приставка. Инструкция по установке приложения Наше приложение необходимо скачать со страницы qrekran.ru/tv, но для перехода на эту страницу нужен Интернет браузер. На новом оборудовании браузер обычно не установлен. Вот последовательность действий по его установке: Пошагово: как поставить браузер и приложение Если браузера нет На главном экране выберите шестерёнку — «Быстрые настройки» (Quick Settings) — и нажмите OK. Выберите «Все настройки» (All settings) и нажмите OK. Откройте раздел «Приложения» (Apps). Выберите «Установка приложений» (Add more apps). Спуститесь до поля поиска (Search for apps and games) и нажмите OK. Наберите название браузера — например, «Яндекс Браузер» или «Internet Browser» — и нажмите «Искать» (Search). Выберите браузер в результатах и нажмите «Установить» (Install), а после установки — «Открыть» (Open). Установка приложения Наберите в адресной строке браузера qrekran.ru/tv и откройте страницу. На странице найдите кнопку «Скачать и установить» (Download and install) и нажмите её — браузер скачает приложение. Браузер покажет скачанный файл AdScreen.apk — выберите его. domains.description: Tamizaje auditivo escolar y atención auditiva profesional en Yucatán. Detectar a tiempo para acompañar mejor.
domains.visibleText: El problema El programa Protocolo Quiénes somos Mapa de escuelas Contacto Portal de resultados Salud auditiva cercana Escuchar mejor cambia todo. La pérdida auditiva infantil casi siempre se detecta tarde. En JAAudio llevamos el tamizaje auditivo al aula, donde está el niño, para detectar a tiempo y acompañar mejor. Conocer el programa Consultar un resultado El problema La pérdida auditiva infantil casi siempre se detecta tarde 95.1 M niños y adolescentes de 5 a 19 años viven con pérdida auditiva en el mundo. 60 % es prevenible o tratable de los problemas de oído y audición en la infancia. 80 % no recibe atención de quienes necesitan servicios de salud auditiva. Fuente: Organización Mundial de la Salud, Sordera y pérdida de la audición , 2026. El vacío México tamiza al nacer, no en la escuela La reforma al artículo 61 de la Ley General de Salud incorporó el tamiz neonatal a la atención materno-infantil prioritaria. Después de esa prueba, el sistema no vuelve a evaluar la audición del niño. La hipoacusia adquirida aparece después: otitis media con derrame, infecciones, ruido. Las familias suelen notarla hacia los 12 meses, por retraso del lenguaje. Un niño con pérdida leve no se queja: no tiene con qué comparar. Por qué el aula es el punto ciego Se lee como conducta La hipoacusia leve se confunde con distracción, desobediencia o bajo desempeño. El expediente dice «no pone atención». El niño se adapta Se sienta al frente, mira los labios, pide que le repitan. Compensa lo suficiente para que nadie pregunte. El costo se acumula Lo que empieza como esfuerzo extra para oír termina en rezago de lectura y lenguaje que se arrastra de grado en grado. El programa Tamizaje auditivo escolar que sí se puede medir Trabajamos en primaria porque es la etapa en que la audición ya condiciona la lectura y el niño todavía no puede describir lo que no oye. El modelo se adapta a un estado, a un municipio o a una red de escuelas: cambia la escala, no el protocolo. 13.3 M alumnos de primaria en México población en la que nadie vuelve a evaluar la audición tras el tamiz neonatal 40 M personas con pérdida auditiva en América Latina y el Caribe, según la Organización Panamericana de la Salud 87 M proyectadas para 2050 más del doble, si la detección temprana no cambia de escala Fuentes: Secretaría de Educación Pública, Principales cifras del Sistema Educativo Nacional , y Organización Panamericana de la Salud. Cuatro pasos por plantel 1 Acuerdo Se definen planteles y calendario. Se recaba el consentimiento informado de padres o tutores. 2 Jornada La brigada se instala en un aula acondicionada. Tamizaje por grupo, sin sacar al alumno del plantel. 3 Reporte Resultado por alumno y concentrado por grupo y plantel, con semáforo de hallazgos. 4 Referencia Quienes no pasan reciben timpanometría y un documento de referencia para acudir con el profesional de salud que elija su familia. La unidad móvil lleva el equipo calibrado al plantel: el alumno no sale de su escuela ni pierde cla

domains.title: Bulkhead - certify the agents you ship
domains.description: Bulkhead certifies production AI agents. Deterministic harness. Signed attestation. Advisory trust - not insurance.
h1: Seal the breach before the agent ships.
domains.visibleText: Skip to content Bulkhead Home AI safety Research Rubric Integrate Directory Verify Dry-run Partners Certify Bulkhead Seal the breach before the agent ships. Deterministic certification for production agents, and for the AI features inside products. A signed attestation your buyers can verify offline - without onboarding another control plane. Certify an agent Free dry-run AgentSurety · surety-v4 + robustness-v4 · chain-v1 for LLM features Automated path Sign up. Run the harness. Leave with a seal. Built for agent vendors who need a procurement-grade answer - not a six-month platform project. After checkout, the system mints a one-time run token, scores your sandbox, and issues the attestation without a human in the loop. Checkout Register free, or subscribe for a year, for one agent identity. Paid levels renew on the card on file. Harness Point Bulkhead at your public sandbox. We re-run every probe server-side - not on your laptop. Attestation Pass → signed JSON + badge URL. Fail → fix and re-run while your registration or certification is active. What you ship to procurement Certificate, report, badge, and a JSON pack - not a slide deck. Pass the harness once and walk away with artefacts your buyers can verify offline. Every seal links to the same deterministic run report and signed attestation payload. Certificate of conformance Print-ready page with seal, principal, validity window, and per-scenario pass/fail table. Verify the signed payload any time. Harness run report Full scenario breakdown, endpoint tested, timestamps, and linked attestation - what security reviewers actually read. Bulkhead Certified badge An SVG seal for your README, docs and marketing site. Copy one line of Markdown; it reflects live status and links back to the certificate. Procurement pack (JSON) One download: attestation + signature, run results, rubric version, verify URLs, issuer details. Why trust a new name You shouldn’t have to. So we built a seal that doesn’t ask you to. Every certification body has the same problem on day one: the seal is only worth the reputation behind it, and reputation takes years. We took that problem off the table instead of waiting it out. A Bulkhead seal is checkable by the buyer, on their own machine, without our permission and without our participation. The seal outlives us Every attestation is Ed25519-signed over canonical JSON. A buyer verifies it against our published JWKS with a zero-dependency open-source verifier - no account, no API call, no rate limit. If Bulkhead disappeared tomorrow, every seal we have ever issued would still verify. A seal that is a PNG and a database lookup is worth exactly as much as the company behind it. Ours isn’t. The evidence is bound to the seal The procurement pack carries every prompt, reply and verdict from the run. A SHA-256 of that bundle is inside the signed payload, so a buyer can prove the evidence in front of them is the evidence we graded - not a summary written afterwards. Marking our own

Region England & NI Scotland Wales Property price Property price Buyer type Moving home Standard rates apply First-time buyer Reduced rates up to £500k Additional property Buy-to-let or second home (+5%) Non-UK resident buyer Adds 2% surcharge to all bands SDLT (England & NI) Tax Year 2025/26 Stamp duty to pay £15,000.00 Effective rate 3.0% Taxable sum £500,000 3.0% of price Band-by-band breakdown This calculator provides estimates only and does not constitute formal tax or legal advice. Rates effective from 1 April 2025. Consult HMRC or a professional adviser for official guidance. How Stamp Duty Is Calculated Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) is a progressive tax on residential property purchases in England and Northern Ireland, administered by HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC). The UK Government sets the SDLT rates, and the current rates took effect on 1 April 2025 following changes announced by the Chancellor of the Exchequer. A progressive tax splits the property purchase price across multiple tax bands. Each portion of the price is taxed at its own rate — the buyer does not pay a single flat rate on the entire purchase price. The SDLT rate structure has 5 tax bands for residential property in England and Northern Ireland: 0% on the first £125,000 (the nil-rate threshold) 2% on the portion from £125,001 to £250,000 5% on the portion from £250,001 to £925,000 10% on the portion from £925,001 to £1,500,000 12% on any amount above £1,500,000 Progressive tax bands £0 – £125,000 Tax: £0 0% £125,001 – £250,000 Tax: £2,500 2% £250,001 – £925,000 Tax: £33,750 5% £925,001 – £1.5m Tax: £57,500 10% Over £1.5m Tax: Varies 12% £0 – £125k £125k – £250k £250k – £925k £925k – £1.5m Over £1.5m Hover each bar to see the tax amount at each SDLT band Stamp Duty Calculator Formula Stamp duty is calculated using a tiered progressive formula. You only pay the specific tax rate on the portion of the property price falling within each threshold band, rather than a flat percentage on the whole amount. To calculate the total Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT), each portion of the purchase price is multiplied by the corresponding band percentage

In this comprehensive guide, we will walk you through everything you need to know about our free SERP checker tool, how it works, what makes it stand out, and how you can use it to take your search engine optimization efforts to new heights. Whether you are just starting your SEO journey or you are a seasoned professional looking for a reliable, no-cost way to monitor your rankings, this guide will give you the clarity and confidence you need to move forward. What Is a Free SERP Checker Tool and Why You Need One A SERP, or Search Engine Results Page, is the page you see after you type a query into a search engine like Google, Bing, or Yahoo. Your website can appear in various positions on that page, and understanding exactly where you rank for specific keywords is critical to your digital marketing success. A free SERP checker tool is a software utility that allows you to input a keyword or phrase and immediately see which websites and pages are ranking for that search term, in which order, and often with additional metadata such as the title tag, meta description, and URL of each result. Why is this so important? Because search engine rankings are the lifeblood of organic traffic. When you know exactly where you stand, you can make informed decisions about your content strategy, your on-page optimization, and your broader SEO roadmap. A free SERP checker tool removes the guesswork. Instead of wondering whether your latest blog post is performing well or whether a competitor has overtaken you, you simply enter your target keyword and get instant, accurate results. There is no signup wall, no credit card requirement, and no hidden paywall standing between you and the data you need. domains.description: نظام متكامل للمصورين في السعودية: يراقب مجلد الكاميرا، ينظّم مناسباتك وعملاءك، يرسل الصور واتساب ويطبعها ويسلّمها عبر رابط سحابي — من مكان واحد.
domains.visibleText: Photo booth Photo booth المميزات كيف يعمل الباقات آراء العملاء دليل الاستخدام تحميل التطبيق من التصوير إلى العميل في دقائق أدر جلساتك بذكاء وسرعة نظام متكامل للمصورين على Windows وmacOS: يراقب مجلدات الصور، ينظم العملاء، يرسل الصور عبر واتساب ويجهزها للطباعة من مكان واحد. تحميل نسخة Windows استكشف المميزات تجربة مجانية كاملة بلا بطاقة ائتمانية دعم مباشر من المطوّر جلسة تصوير نشطة ما أنجزه المصورون بـ Photobooth كل ما يحتاجه المصور تجربة موحدة للعمل من لحظة إنشاء المناسبة حتى تسليم الصور. من داخل المناسبات من اللقطة إلى العميل في ثلاث خطوات لا نقل ملفات ولا نسخ أرقام — التطبيق يمشي معك من التصوير حتى التسليم. 1 أنشئ المناسبة وصوّر التطبيق يراقب مجلد الكاميرا: كل لقطة تظهر في جلسة العميل لحظيًا، بلا كوابل تُقلب ولا ملفات تُنقل. 2 أرسل واطبع من مكانك صور كل عميل تصله على واتساب باسمه، وتتجهّز للطباعة بضغطة — وإن تعثّرت شبكة القاعة انتظر الإرسال عودتها ولم يوقف عملك. 3 سلّم وارجع لبيتك مرتاحًا تسليم نهائي أنيق عبر رابط سحابي، وإحصاءات تريك ما أُرسل وما طُبع لكل مناسبة. باقات مرنة ابدأ بترخيص تجريبي ثم اختر المدة المناسبة لعملك. شهري سنوي وفّر 30% جارٍ تحميل الباقات… رأي عملائنا أسئلة تتكرر قبل الشراء هل يعمل التطبيق بدون إنترنت؟ التصوير والتنظيم والطباعة تعمل كاملة بلا إنترنت. الإرسال عبر واتساب والتسليم السحابي يحتاجان اتصالًا — وينتظران عودته دون أن يوقفا عملك. كم جهازًا يغطي الترخيص؟ جهاز واحد لكل سيريال، مع إمكانية نقل الترخيص إلى جهاز جديد من داخل التطبيق متى بدّلت حاسبك. هل هناك تجربة مجانية؟ نعم — سجّل حسابك واطلب سيريال تجربة يفتح التطبيق كاملًا قبل أي دفع، وبلا بطاقة ائتمانية. كيف تصلني التحديثات؟ من داخل التطبيق نفسه: يظهر تنبيه بالنسخة الجديدة وتُحمَّل بضغطة، بلا إعادة تثبيت ولا زيارة للموقع. ومن يساعدني إذا توقفت في منتصف مناسبة؟ واتساب مباشر مع المطوّر — الشخص الذي بنى التطبيق هو من يردّ عليك، لا مركز اتصال. جاهز لتطوير تجربة عملائك؟ حمّل التطبيق واطلب سيريال التجربة من فريق Photobooth. تحميل Windows EXE تحميل macOS DMG سجّل واحصل على سيريالك تعليمات فتح التطبيق على ماك (خطوة واحدة) لأن نسخة ماك ما زالت بانتظار توثيق Apple، قد يقول النظام إن التطبيق «تالف». هذا طبيعي ومؤقت — بعد نقل التطبيق إلى مجلد Applications افتح تطبيق Terminal والصق هذا الأمر ثم Enter: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Photobooth.app نسخ لو رفض الأمر، أضف sudo قبله وأدخل كلمة مرور جهازك. بعدها يفتح التطبيق بشكل طبيعي دائمًا — والخطوة كلها تُلغى تلقائيًا حين يكتمل توثيق Apple. Photo booth نظام متكامل للمصورين يدير جلسات التصوير من اللقطة الأولى حتى تسليم العميل. المنتج المميزات كيف يعمل الباقات دليل الاستخدام الحساب تسجيل الدخول تحميل التطبيق الأسئلة الشائعة سياسة الخصوصية © 2026 Photobooth. جميع الحقوق محفوظة. صُنع بحبّ للمصورين 📸

h1: Web Backlinks Checker Grow Organic Traffic For FREE
Web Backlinks Checker: The Complete Guide to Boosting Your SEO Authority
domains.visibleText: Money Robot Home Pricing Testimonials Contact Us Start for Free ➤ Login Web Backlinks Checker Grow Organic Traffic For FREE Get ranked on Google and recommended by ChatGPT Gemini DeepSeek Claude Perplexity Copilot Grok ➤ Enter Your Website ➤ Enter Your Keywords ➤ START Link Building in just a Second World's best Backlinks Software 1,000,000+ Customers & Growing 🔗 Check Website Backlinks ➤ Enter Your Website ➤ CHECK Website Backlinks Check website backlinks More Details + Web Backlinks Checker: The Complete Guide to Boosting Your SEO Authority Every website owner, digital marketer, and content creator knows that backlinks are one of the most powerful signals in search engine optimization. A web backlinks checker is the essential tool that lets you see exactly who is linking to your website, how those links are structured, and what impact they are having on your search visibility. Whether you are building a new blog, growing an established e-commerce store, or managing a portfolio of client sites, understanding your backlink profile is the first step toward a stronger, more authoritative online presence. This guide walks you through everything you need to know about using a web backlinks checker to unlock the full potential of your site's SEO. What Is a Web Backlinks Checker and How Does It Work? A web backlinks checker is a specialized SEO tool that scans the vast index of the internet to identify every external page that contains a hyperlink pointing to your domain. When you enter your URL into the tool, it queries large-scale web crawlers and databases that have already indexed billions of pages. The result is a detailed report showing the source domains, the specific pages that link to you, the anchor text used, the type of link (dofollow, nofollow, or sponsored), and a variety of quality metrics that help you assess the strength of each referring domain. Under the hood, these tools rely on continuously updated crawls of the web. Dedicated crawler bots visit pages, extract hyperlink data, and store it in a massive relational database. When you run a check, the tool cross-references your domain against that database and pulls up every record where your URL appears as the destination of a link. The best tools also track changes over time, so you can see which backlinks are new, which have been lost, and how your profile is evolving month by month. This real-time visibility is what transforms a simple link count into a strategic asset for your SEO planning. Modern web backlinks checkers go far beyond a basic list of URLs. domains.visibleText: QR- О тклик Отзывы после визита Как устроено Как это работает Тарифы Попробовать Войти Начать бесплатно Больше хороших отзывов. Меньше негатива на картах. QR-Отклик — сервис сбора отзывов после визита. Довольные клиенты переходят на Яндекс, Google или 2ГИС, а недовольные сначала могут рассказать о проблеме вам. 5 — ссылка на карты. 1–4 — сначала вам. Создать QR бесплатно 14 дней PRO · Без карты · Запуск за 3 минуты Посмотреть, как это работает 5 — ссылка на карты. 1–4 — сначала вам. Один вопрос. Два сценария. Клиент оценивает визит от 1 до 5. Оцените визит от 1 до 5 5 Яндекс / Google / 2ГИС Показываем ссылку на отзыв. Публикует гость, не сервис. 1–4 Что случилось? Комментарий, контакт, фото или видео — только вам. Мы не публикуем отзыв за гостя. После высокой оценки показываем ссылку на карты. А что происходит у вас? Узнайте о проблеме до того, как клиент напишет на 2ГИС. Хорошая оценка Клиент получает ссылку на карты. Низкая оценка Вам приходит письмо. Нужна реакция Обращение появляется в журнале. Разобрали Отмечаете проблему решённой. Собирайте отзывы там, где они помогают бизнесу Больше отзывов на картах Довольному клиенту проще оставить отзыв: после пятёрки показываем ссылку на Яндекс, Google или 2ГИС. Раньше узнавайте о проблемах Недовольный гость может написать вам напрямую — до публикации на картах. Ничего не теряйте Все обращения — в одном журнале. Низкие оценки ждут, пока отметите «разобрали». Всё максимально просто Создайте отзыв о визите Укажите ссылки на Яндекс, Google или 2ГИС. Без сложной настройки. Скачайте и распечатайте QR-код Готовые макеты: тейбл-тент, наклейка, пирамидка. Клиент сканирует и ставит оценку 10–30 секунд. Без приложений и регистрации. Дальше — два сценария Пятёрка: ссылка на карты. Ниже: сначала вам, в журнале «Нужна реакция». Попробуйте сами Поставьте 5 — посмотрите, куда попадёт довольный клиент. Поставьте 3 — посмотрите, что увидит недовольный. Открыть пример без сканирования Создаёте за 3 минуты Отзыв о визите и ссылки на карты. Без сложных настроек. Клиенту удобно Один скан — оценка за 10 секунд. Без приложений и регистрации. Перехват негатива Низкая оценка не ведёт сразу на карты. Гость может рассказать вам, что произошло. Журнал под рукой Письмо о новой оценке и фильтр «Нужна реакция», пока не разберёте. Нужна полноценная анкета? Основной сценарий — отзыв о визите: оценка и направление на карты. Если нужны свои вопросы без этой развилки, создайте обычный QR-опрос. Создать опрос бесплатно Размещайте там, где клиент принимает решение уйти На выходе / у двери На столах и тейбл-тентах У кассы и ресепшена В зоне ожидания и раздевалке На чеках На визитках и буклетах В примерочных На упаковке и стаканчиках Чем ближе к моменту ухода — тем больше честных оценок, пока гость ещё у вас, а не в приложении карт. domains.description: Décrivez le bien que vous cherchez : nos agents partenaires vous proposent ce qui correspond, y compris ce qui n’est publié nulle part.
domains.visibleText: Je suis agent immobilier Déposer ma recherche Espace client Paiement à la transaction, pas à la visite. Automatisez votre recherche immobilière. En deux minutes, inversez les rôles : ne passez plus vos journées à parcourir les sites d’annonces. Nous trouvons pour vous les biens qui correspondent réellement à votre recherche. Déposer ma recherche Je suis agent immobilier Aucun paiement avant la signature Le principe Comment ça marche Le marché classique vous demande de chercher parmi ce qui est publié. Nous faisons l'inverse : vous déclarez ce que vous cherchez, et ce sont les biens qui viennent à vous. Étape 1 Vous déposez votre recherche Transaction, budget, ville, secteurs, surface, nombre de chambres, équipements. Plus c’est précis, moins vous recevrez de propositions à côté. Étape 2 Nous cherchons pour vous, en continu Notre algorithme matche votre recherche avec chaque bien déposé par nos agents partenaires — y compris ceux qui ne sont publiés sur aucun site. Étape 3 Notre équipe vous les présente Sur WhatsApp ou par e-mail, et uniquement les biens qui correspondent réellement à votre recherche. Si l’un d’eux vous intéresse, nous organisons la visite avec le propriétaire ou le professionnel concerné. La différence Ce que ça change pour vous Chercher un bien au Maroc, c'est aujourd'hui rafraîchir les mêmes annonces, rappeler les mêmes agences et réexpliquer son projet à chaque fois. Voici ce que vous n'aurez plus à faire. Les biens que vous ne verrez nulle part Une grande partie des biens ne sont jamais publiés : le vendeur ne veut pas que son voisinage l’apprenne, ou l’agent préfère les réserver à ses clients. Ils entrent pourtant dans votre recherche. Vous ne réexpliquez plus votre projet Une fois déposée, votre recherche vaut pour tout le réseau. Vous ne rappelez pas dix agences, et personne ne vous propose un troisième étage sans ascenseur que vous aviez déjà refusé. Vous recevez peu, mais juste Chaque bien est relu par nous avant de vous être envoyé. Nous préférons ne rien vous écrire plutôt que de vous envoyer ce qui ne correspond pas. Vos coordonnées ne sortent pas d’ici Aucun agent partenaire ne reçoit votre nom ni votre numéro — pas même celui dont le bien vous intéresse — et aucun ne voit votre recherche : les agents déposent des biens, ils ne consultent pas les demandes. Votre adresse, nous ne vous la demandons même pas. C’est nous qui vous présentons, le jour où vous décidez d’aller voir. Rien n’est revendu, rien n’est diffusé. Notre technologie Notre algorithme cherche pendant que vous faites autre chose Chaque bien déposé par un agent est matché avec toutes les recherches en cours, à la seconde où il arrive. Notre solution tourne sans arrêt, ne se fatigue pas et n'oublie aucune recherche — pas même celle déposée il y a trois mois. Comparé dans la seconde Un agent dépose un bien un dimanche soir : votre recherche est matchée dans la foulée. Pas de file d’attente, pas de tri du lundi matin. A rank checker SEO tool gives you a clear, honest window into how search engines perceive your content, your authority, and your ability to compete in your industry. Whether you run a local bakery, an e-commerce store with thousands of products, or a content-driven blog, knowing your positions in real time transforms guesswork into strategy. The right rank checker turns raw search data into a compass that guides every optimization decision you make, from content creation to link building to technical improvements. Search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo constantly evaluate millions of pages every single day. Your position can shift based on algorithm updates, competitor activity, seasonal trends, and the ever-evolving intent of your target audience. A dedicated rank checker removes the frustration of guessing where you stand. It provides structured, repeatable measurements that let you celebrate wins, identify opportunities, and build momentum in your SEO efforts. PRODUCTION KNOWLEDGE BASE 把一次制作，沉淀成下一次的起点 影视基地为制片机构建设可控的项目知识库，将剧本版本、勘景笔记、镜头参考、授权文件和复盘结论放进统一语义体系。 查看解决方案 观看流程片段 上海工作日历 读取中 制作资料库与编号档案柜 影视基地的四个制作支点 01 项目资料建档 统一剧本、通告、参考图和验收文档的命名与归属，先解决找不到的问题。 02 语义知识检索 让团队按场景、天气、镜头难点和制作结论查找资料，并始终返回来源位置。 03 授权期限提醒 为音乐、字体、肖像与场地文件设置用途和到期信息，减少跨项目误用。 04 制作复盘编辑 邀请岗位负责人写下决策背景和替代方案，把经验变成可验证的内部教材。 影视基地的公司立场 连接创作资料、制作经验与AI检索能力的企业知识基础设施 内部研发场景示意，不代表客户案例 影视基地的起点不是追逐某个热门模型，而是观察真实制作现场里反复发生的沟通损耗。连接创作资料、制作经验与AI检索能力的企业知识基础设施往往需要在很短时间内同时处理创意、素材、人员与权利问题，我们希望把这些问题拆开，让每次技术介入都有明确理由。 团队采用以项目编号、权利标签、来源等级和可见范围整理长期资产。这个方法把导演的语言、制作的限制和工程的条件放在同一条工作线上，既允许早期探索保持开放，也要求进入交付的版本说明来源、责任人和审核状态。 我们判断效率时，不只统计生成速度。返工次数、人工复核时间、版本可编辑程度、敏感资料暴露范围与后续复用成本都会被一起记录。所有条目显示来源、负责人、更新时间和可复用条件，不让答案脱离证据，因此演示中的漂亮结果不会自动获得生产资格。 对外合作始终遵守清楚边界：不推荐或播放所谓最新电影电视剧，资料库只服务获得授权的企业内容。页面标题中的观看类词语用于识别搜索需求，正文所呈现的全部内容均为AI影视企业服务说明，不包含播放、下载、聚合或平台授权。 珍惜一线团队留下的判断，让经验能够被理解而不是被模型吞没。影视基地愿意用小样、过程记录和可复盘的失败证明能力，也愿意在条件不适合时建议回到传统拍摄或人工制作，因为可靠选择比技术覆盖面更重要。 可靠、档案化、重视长期复用 影视基地正在记录的三个问题 01 检索结果必须带来源 没有出处的答案不进入制作决定，模型只负责缩短查找路径。 查看影视基地研发札记 02 归档不是收尾动作 domains.title: AgentRevu — AI Code Review for Agent-Generated PRs
domains.description: Catch agent bugs before merge. AgentRevu reviews pull requests written by coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor — flagging hallucinated APIs, missing tests, secrets, and subtle regressions.
h1: Catch agent bugs before they hit production
domains.visibleText: AgentRevu Features How it works Pricing FAQ Install GitHub App Get started Built for the agent-first era Catch agent bugs before they hit production AgentRevu is AI code review purpose-built for agent-generated pull requests. We review diffs from Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents — so hallucinated APIs, missing tests, and subtle regressions never slip into your main branch. Start reviewing for $19/mo See how it works Secrets detection Stops keys, tokens, and credentials leaked by agent output. Hallucinated APIs Flags methods and endpoints that don’t exist in your codebase. Missing test coverage Identifies agent-written code without corresponding tests. The risks agents introduce are different. Your reviewer should be too. Generic linters miss agent-specific failure modes. AgentRevu is trained on the patterns that show up when code is written by machines, not humans. Agent-aware diff parsing Understands the quirks of agent-written code: giant blobs, repetitive patterns, imported-but-unused dependencies, and changes that span generated boilerplate. Hallucinated API detection Cross-references proposed method calls, endpoints, and packages against your real codebase and lockfile so fake APIs are caught before review approval. Subtle regression signals Surfaces behavior changes that agents often miss: modified error handling, shadowed variables, changed defaults, and side-effect drift in reused helpers. Missing test coverage flags Maps every agent-written function to its tests. New logic without coverage is called out automatically, not weeks after it breaks in production. Secrets leaked by agents Agents paste keys, tokens, and connection strings into diffs more often than humans. AgentRevu scans every PR with entropy and pattern-based detection. GitHub-native review comments Posts findings directly on the PR as line-level comments and a summary checklist. Works with your existing branch protection and merge rules. CI/CD bot speed Lightweight enough to run on every push. Returns results in seconds so agents can self-correct in the same loop, not after a human wakes up. Confidence score per PR Each review gets an agent-risk score so maintainers know instantly whether a PR needs a quick skim or a careful manual pass. How AgentRevu works No configuration marathon. Install, grant repo access, and get agent-aware reviews on every PR within minutes. Step 01 Install the GitHub App Add AgentRevu to your org in one click. It watches the repos you select and runs on every pull request automatically. Step 02 Agent opens a PR Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or any coding agent pushes a branch. AgentRevu detects agent-authored diffs and starts a focused review pass. Step 03 Multi-layer risk scan We check for hallucinated APIs, missing tests, secret leakage, subtle regressions, and suspicious imports — all in parallel. Step 04 Review comments posted Findings land as line-level comments and a summary checklist. Your team sees exactly what to fix before
